title: Trench Map
description: Enhance an infinite image using a 9-pixel window lookup algorithm.
writeup:
## Approach

The image enhancement maps each pixel's 3×3 neighborhood (read as a 9-bit binary number) to the enhancement algorithm string. Store only the lit (`#`) pixels in a set for efficient sparse representation.

The tricky part is the **infinite background**. If `algorithm[0] == '#'`, then all-dark neighborhoods (index 0) become lit — meaning the entire infinite background lights up on odd steps. If `algorithm[511] == '.'`, it goes dark again on even steps. Track this background state and use it when sampling pixels outside the current bounds.

## Part 1

Apply 2 enhancement steps, expanding the working area by 1 pixel in each direction per step. Count lit pixels after step 2.

## Part 2

Same algorithm for 50 steps. The set-based representation keeps things manageable since only the region near the original image has interesting structure.
